title: Tailwise Pharmacy Early-Refill Override Allowances by Class
content:
A pharmacist at Tailwise Pharmacy may in some classes dispense a refill before the refill-too-soon date. This schedule lists, per class, whether such an override exists at all, how many may be used, how large a travel fill may be, and whether lost or damaged medication may be replaced early.

| Class | Early-refill override allowed | Overrides per prescription in any rolling 365 days | Largest days' supply of a travel override fill | Lost or damaged medication may be replaced early |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | Yes | 1 | 180 days | Yes |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | Yes | 2 | 90 days | Yes |
| Rx Prescription Diet | Yes | 2 | 90 days | Yes |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | No | 0 | 0 days | No |
| Rx Controlled Substance | No | 0 | 0 days | No |
| Rx Compounded Medication | Yes | 1 | 30 days | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Early-refill override allowed**: whether a pharmacist may dispense before the refill-too-soon date for travel or for lost or damaged medication.
- **Overrides per rolling 365 days**: early-refill overrides allowed per prescription in any rolling 365 days.
- **Travel override fill**: the largest days' supply a travel override fill may contain.
- **Lost or damaged replacement**: whether lost or damaged medication may be replaced early as an override.

## Points of reading

- Rx Short-Course Medication and Rx Controlled Substance show zero in every column: no early refill exists for these classes.
- An Rx Maintenance Medication or Rx Prescription Diet prescription may use up to 2 overrides in any rolling 365 days; an Rx Preventive or Rx Compounded Medication prescription 1.
